text:
The plate holds about 9 to 10 small dark pieces, which look like olives (kalamata) or possibly dates. Several are cut in half, so I'm treating them as roughly 8 whole olives' worth of food.

If they are kalamata olives at about 4 g each, the total is roughly 35 g. Olives run about 115 kcal per 100 g, which gives about 40 kcal.

If they are dates, pieces of this size would be about 7 g each, or roughly 60 g in total. At about 280 kcal per 100 g, that would be about 170 kcal.

The pieces look glossy and dark purple-brown, which fits olives better, so I'm going with the olive estimate. I'm shading it slightly higher in case some pieces are larger than they appear.
